decisions.reason: Adding supported Transak payment methods does not change the mint price or revenue-allocation rules.
The same-message FAQ introduction already states that Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Supported fiat payment methods do not change the referral code's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The Transak payment-method list does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limit.
Supported fiat payment methods do not alter the Big Block prize parameters, funding, ticket rules, or counted sale types.
The Transak payment-method change does not alter any NFT metadata field or visibility rule.
Supported primary-mint fiat methods do not change the state or entitlements transferred during NFT resale.
Supported fiat payment methods do not alter the Small Block prize parameters, funding, ticket rules, or counted sale types.
Adding Transak payment methods does not change the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
Supported fiat payment methods do not change badge triggers, referral milestones, or on-chain badge recording.
The Transak payment-method list does not change the selected blockchain or network class.
Supported fiat payment methods do not change the deferred Discord community and support-server requirement.
